_comment: The conservative collection-role map for mxm-mono-pr1.
Only controls whose meaning matches an existing role are claimed. The independent waveform
switches cannot truthfully fill a single wave selector.
Osc 2 tune is the B oscillator's interval control. The B-to-A sync switch occupies osc2.sync
because it enables oscillator 2 as oscillator 1's sync source. noise_external_level fills the
third mixer source, the noise level; the external input the id is named for was removed.
The five routing roles below name the route the INIT patch wires, per the control map's
amendment: a fixed knob's promise is about Init, and re-pointing a route is the player's act.
Each of those pairs is present in Init at zero depth precisely so the role is not a dead knob:
an absent route contributes nothing whatever its amount holds.
